texts: The last UEFA Champions League was won by Chelsea in the 2020-2021 season. They defeated Manchester City in the final on May 29, 2021, with a score of 1-0. The goal was scored by Kai Havertz in the 42nd minute.
The 2022 UEFA Champions League was won by Real Madrid. They defeated Liverpool 1-0 in the final on May 28, 2022.

The winner of the most recent UEFA Champions League final was:

**Manchester City** defeated Paris Saint-Germain 1-0 in the 2023 UEFA Champions League final, which took place on June 3, 2023, at the Giuseppe Meazza Stadium in Milan, Italy. This was Manchester City's third Champions League title.

The last UEFA Champions League was won by Bayern Munich in the 2020-2021 season. They defeated Paris Saint-Germain in the final. The match was played on May 29, 2021, at the Estadio do Dragão in Porto, Portugal. Bayern Munich won the match 1-0 through a headed goal by Joshua Kimmich in the 59th minute, securing their sixth UEFA Champions League title.
